description.value: At 3rd level, normally, armor of any kind interferes with a spell-caster's gestures, which can cause spells to fail if those spells have a somatic component. A geomancer's limited focus and specialized training, however, allows her to avoid spell failure so long as she sticks to light armor and light shields. This training does not extend to medium armor or heavy shields. This ability does not apply to spells gained from a different spell-casting class.
